description_en: Invoke GetLoginDetails to obtain the agent's logon information, including basic agent information, server address information, authentication information, and more. This API can only be invoked by the agent themselves; administrators are not permitted to invoke it on behalf of others
description_zh: 调用GetLoginDetails获取坐席的登录信息，包括坐席基本信息、服务器地址信息、鉴权信息等，该接口只允许自己调用，管理员无权替他人调用
kebab_example: aliyun ccc get-login-details --instance-id ccc-test --user-id agent@ccc-test --chat-device-id 4c51c9116c36537cb850dc1081d745df --api-version 2020-07-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetLoginDetails

parameters.help_en: Agent ID. This parameter is optional. If not specified, the agent mapped to the current RAM account is used by default
parameters.help_zh: 坐席ID，非必填，不填则默认使用当前RAM账户映射的坐席
parameters.name: user_id
